O que é a Campanha de Retenção?

  • A função de Retenção em um call center é estratégica e voltada para manter os clientes na empresa, especialmente aqueles que demonstram intenção de cancelar serviços ou migrar para a concorrência.
  • O objetivo principal é evitar cancelamentos e prolongar o relacionamento com o cliente.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Diagnóstico da insatisfação: ouvir com atenção, identificar o motivo do cancelamento e entender o contexto do cliente;
  • Negociação personalizada: oferecer alternativas como descontos, bônus, upgrades ou ajustes no plano para atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Registro e atualização de dados: documentar cada interação no sistema, incluindo motivos da chamada e soluções propostas;
  • Aplicação de técnicas de persuasão: usar empatia, escuta ativa e argumentos estratégicos para convencer o cliente a permanecer;
  • Cumprimento de metas: trabalhar com indicadores como taxa de retenção, tempo médio de atendimento e índice de reversão;
  • Feedback interno: reportar padrões de reclamações ou sugestões dos clientes para áreas responsáveis por melhorias, etc.

description:
Project Kuiper is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low‑latency, high‑speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Amazon Kuiper is seeking an experienced, self‑motivated Sales Professional to lead the adoption of Amazon Kuiper broadband and related services with maritime and offshore partners and end users in Brazil. This role is a unique opportunity to build and execute our sales pipeline with major offshore operators, service contractors, and merchant marine customers.

The ideal candidate has a strong track record in selling to, managing, and supporting large Energy sector clients, with maritime experience preferred. Knowledge of agriculture, OEM, and aviation industries is a plus. A solid understanding of satellite communications, experience working with global remote teams, and the ability to manage complex, long‑term deals from start to finish are essential.

You will be responsible for growing maritime and mobility opportunities in Brazil, managing both direct and channel engagements. This includes working with local partners to establish infrastructure that supports high‑value contracts and leading cross‑functional teams to deliver on customer and partner initiatives. Strong relationship skills and fluency in English and Portuguese are required.

Please note: This role may involve access to information or technology subject to U.S. export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). Employment is contingent on obtaining any necessary licenses or approvals from the U.S. government, based on eligibility under these regulations.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the build out of Amazon Leo service revenue with specific focus on Maritime customers and end users.
  • Be customer obsessed. Think on behalf of the customer and work to meet the customer’s stated and unstated needs and aspirations.
  • Execute strategic and tactical business development initiatives while working with key internal stakeholders (e.g., Amazon Leo product and engineering teams, legal, finance) and BD team colleagues.
  • Be the internal coordinator supporting complex contract negotiations, tender drafting and complex business requirements and activities which deliver results.
  • Adept at thinking strategically and analytically about business priorities, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to deliver target based results working cross‑organizationally.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications including a passion for writing detailed strategic documents and a preference for a second fluent spoken language.
  • Consistently exceeds key performance metrics and delivers results.
  • Experience driving consensus across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must be able to articulate business value & technical approach.

A Day in the Life

Kuiper's Sales strategy and Go To Market plan is well defined and yet each working day is different from the next. The satellite Mobility sector is global and our customer engagements take us around the world whether on video calls or supporting face‑to‑face engagements. We may start the day with a customer call with Australia and finish the day with a channel partner meeting in Austin. Taking time during a busy day to evaluate critical data points and develop strategies and tactics is important. As is the process of codifying these decisions and their outcomes.

About the Team

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee‑led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? About the Project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points

  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design

A Petz tem como propósito criar valor e proporcionar a melhor experiência possível na relação entre o pet e o seu tutor. E, para que isso seja possível, temos como visão sermos reconhecidos mundialmente, até 2025, como o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet.

Com uma estratégia omnicanal e que integra não só os canais físicos e digitais, mas também os segmentos de produtos e serviços, somos uma plataforma de soluções completa para os animais de estimação.

Nossa proposta é oferecer aos nossos clientes uma experiência de compra e atendimento diferenciado em nossas lojas físicas, além de agilidade e conveniência em nossos canais digitais. Sim, queremos estar presentes em todos os momentos da vida dos nossos clientes, tutores e pets.

Contamos, também, com a maior rede de centros de estética do Brasil e, sob a marca Seres , com a mais abrangente rede de centros veterinários do país; além de, por meio do maior programa nacional de adoção de cães e gatos, o Adote Petz , fomentamos a criação da conexão emocional do tutor com o seu novo melhor amigo.

E ainda nem falamos dos produtos da marca Petz , que já são mais de 300 itens disponíveis em todas as nossas lojas, sendo líder de vendas nas 25 categorias de produtos ofertados. Com um faturamento que cresce mais de 40% ao ano, isso mostra o quanto somos fortes, inovadores e entregamos produtos de qualidade aos nossos clientes.

E, aos poucos, esse ecossistema vem se expandindo e se fortalecendo com a chegada de grandes marcas do segmento junto ao grupo Petz, dentre elas: , Cansei de Ser Gato, Cão Cidadão e Petix. Legal né?

A estratégia de omnicanalidade nos trouxe até aqui, e assim nos tornamos líderes de mercado e também uma empresa que dobra de tamanho a cada dois anos. Mas somos incansáveis e sabemos que há muito a ser feito, para isso, estamos investindo em fortalecer ainda mais o nosso ecossistema de serviços, produtos e contratação de gente melhor que a gente para continuar alcançando voos ainda mais altos e resultados expressivos.

E você, quer fazer parte deste time de pessoas apaixonadas por pets? Trabalhar num ambiente descomplicado e acolhedor, no qual respeitamos uns aos outros? Onde reconhecemos seus esforços e premiamos resultados? E principalmente, encantamos nossos clientes e temos prazer em servir?

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonisation, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. title: Financial Reporting Jr Analyst
description:
About The Role

As a Financial Reporting Analyst at VTEX, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of consolidated financial reporting. You will support and lead various financial reporting processes, engage in technical accounting matters, and collaborate on projects that enhance efficiencies and decision-making within the organization. This position provides an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment and make a significant impact on VTEX's financial reporting standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare monthly consolidation accounting, elimination entries, and supporting working papers, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes, ensuring compliance with Group accounting policies and standards.
  • Assist with month‑end close procedures, including comprehensive analysis of variances and account reconciliations.
  • Manage technical accounting matters, ensuring alignment with financial reporting accounting standards (USGAAP) and VTEX’s accounting policies.
  • Calculate intercompany costs, monitor mismatches, and oversee transactions between companies such as debt, asset transfers, and cost allocations.
  • Support external and internal audits by providing timely and accurate responses to audit queries and maintaining complete documentation.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve accounting processes and reporting, driving efficiency and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on USGAAP reporting developments and implement changes as required.
  • Participate in special projects, such as ERP implementations and other financial transformation initiatives.
  • Explain variations in financial results and changes occurring during reporting periods.

About The Team

The Consolidation and Financial Reporting team is responsible for consolidating the financial results of VTEX subsidiaries and preparing internal and external financial statements in compliance with USGAAP and SEC requirements. The team collaborates closely with Controllership, Investor Relations, and FP&A, ensuring timely and accurate financial information. At VTEX, you will thrive in a proactive environment where results are celebrated and innovation is encouraged. You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that drive business growth and innovation. You will join a team that values excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. This role offers a chance to make a tangible impact while growing your career in a supportive and dynamic environment.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Production Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in Big 4/public accounting or mid‑to‑large public/global companies.
  • Strong knowledge of USGAAP, BRGAAP, and financial reporting standards, including group consolidation and foreign exchange.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., FCCS, Narrative, PBCS) and intercompany transactions.
  • Strong analytical and systemic thinking to design simple solutions for complex problems.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high‑quality results.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills in English; Portuguese proficiency is a plus.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and self‑motivated with strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders and work collaboratively in a flat organizational structure.

About VTEX

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país. Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa. Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Digital Analytics - Pleno você vai somar ao time de Marketing Data que tem como objetivo garantir a confiabilidade dos dados e impulsionar decisões de marketing guiadas por insights.

Engenharia de Tracking e Implementação

  • Liderar Implementações: Conduzir e supervisionar o ciclo completo de projetos de tracking, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Engenharia e Tecnologia
  • Tradução Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre Marketing (Paid Media, CRM, SEO, etc.) e Tecnologia, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e KPIs em requisitos técnicos detalhados (plano de medição)
  • Desenvolvimento de Data Layer e Tags: Projetar, implementar e validar o dataLayer, scripts de coleta de dados e pixels de mídia no Google Tag Manager (GTM), garantindo a captura correta de eventos e interações

Análise e Extração de Dados

  • Extração e Interpretação de Dados: Utilizar SQL no BigQuery para extrair, organizar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados, identificando tendências, oportunidades de otimização e desafios de performance
  • Mensuração de KPIs: Colaborar com os times internos para entender as necessidades de métricas e KPIs (Aquisição, Ativação, Retenção, Receita), garantindo que sejam corretamente mensurados e que os relatórios reflitam a performance real do negócio

Governança e Qualidade de Dados

  • Assegurar a Qualidade: Definir, documentar e aplicar padrões de Governança de Dados, incluindo a criação e manutenção da documentação técnica (Measurement Plan / Dicionário de Métricas)
  • Auditoria e QA: Implementar rotinas de auditoria e Controle de Qualidade (QA), utilizando debuggers e ferramentas de proxy para garantir a precisão e integridade dos dados coletados e dos relatórios
  • Viabilizar AI/ML: Melhorar continuamente a confiabilidade dos dados para construir uma base sólida, viabilizando modelos de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning de alta performance

Gestão de Projetos e Colaboração

  • Gestão Ágil: Organizar, gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de tracking e projetos de dados, utilizando princípios de metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação para traduzir conceitos técnicos em orientações claras para stakeholders de marketing e tecnologia
  • Perfil Colaborativo: Ser proativo(a) e atuar como um parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das equipes de Negócios e Produto, prosperando em um ambiente dinâmico

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Marketing, Tecnologia, Estatística ou áreas correlacionadas
  • Proficiência em Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) e forte compreensão do design da camada de dados (dataLayer)
  • Proficiência em SQL e familiaridade com data warehouses (como BigQuery) e modelagem de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear o funil de E-commerce e mensurar o ciclo de vida do cliente
  • Compreensão básica de JavaScript aplicada à implementação de rastreamento web
  • Experiência em rotinas de Controle de Qualidade (QA) e documentação técnica (Measurement Plan)
  • Conhecimento intermediário de ferramentas de Analytics para App (ex.: AppsFlyer, Adjust)
  • Curiosidade e entusiasmo para explorar o uso de Inteligência Artificial (AI) e Machine Learning em análises
  • Colaboração e Proatividade: Possuir um perfil altamente colaborativo, atuando como parceiro estratégico das equipes de Negócios e Produto, e demonstrando proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de análise

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados e automação
  • Conhecimento básico de como funcionam modelos de Machine Learning (atribuição baseada em dados, predição de churn)
  • Experiência com Customer Data Platform (CDP) e integração de dados de plataformas de mídia paga (Meta Ads, TikTok, Google Ads) e CRM (Salesforce)
  • Conhecimento de princípios de metodologia ágil

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Benefícios

Candidate-se e venha fazer parte dessa transformação conosco!

Somos o Grupo OLX

Somos o Grupo OLX , um marketplace de classificados 100% digital que conecta mais de 7 milhões de pessoas .
Líder na compra e venda de autos, imóveis e bens de consumo, nosso ecossistema diversificado oferece uma plataforma inovadora para negócios e consumo consciente.
São mais de 500 mil anúncios publicados diariamente e 70 milhões de visitas em nossas plataformas (OLX, VivaReal e Zap Imóveis) por mês. Com tecnologia desenvolvida no Brasil, democratizamos o acesso ao comércio para todos, contribuindo positivamente para a economia.
Ao trabalhar na OLX, você fará parte de uma cultura de alta performance , com os melhores talentos . Pensamos grande e olhamos sempre para o futuro, para liderar nossos mercados. Assim, construímos confiança e geramos impacto real para negócios e na vida das pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Implementar Loops de Verificação Autônoma, aplicando conceitos de Auto-healing code

  • Cultura AI First de verdade: acesso às melhores ferramentas de IA do mercado
  • 100% Remoto
  • Impacto global: seu código melhora a experiência de milhões de gamers

Resumo da vaga

IMPORTANTE: As pessoas interessadas deverão enviar carta de motivação, compartilhando o seu interesse em trabalhar na Empodera e currículo POR EMAIL para ******, com assunto "Coordenadora de projetos", até 18/01/2026. Vaga exclusiva para mulheres, cis e trans. A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres negras, indígenas, LBT e com deficiência.

A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para integrar nosso time e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.

A coordenadora de projetos plenoserá responsável pela coordenação das atividades, cronograma, equipe e parcerias do projeto Futuros Seguros.

As atividades da coordenadora serão desempenhadas objetivando alcançar as metas e resultados no planejamento, implementação da metodologia e na execução das atividades do projeto, garantindo qualidade e alinhamento com a missão e cultura da organização.

Futuros Seguros é um programa exclusivo para adolescentes grávidas e jovens mães, moradoras de comunidades socialmente vulnerabilizadas no Rio de Janeiro. Co-projetado com as participantes, o programa possui uma abordagem holística que, através do esporte, contribui para o seu desenvolvimento e empoderamento.

Quem somos

A Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma organização, sem fins lucrativos, com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional.

Fundada em ****, desenvolve programas e projetos esportivos, com viés educacional, para meninas adolescentes e mulheres periféricas, e capacita organizações de todo o Brasil na criação de espaços seguros para meninas no esporte.

A Empodera é uma organização especializada em gênero e esporte e trabalha em prol do empoderamento de meninas e mulheres, em sua pluralidade, utilizando as práticas corporais e esportivas como ferramentas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades socioemocionais e a discussão de temas-chave para que as atendidas desenvolvam seu pleno potencial e exerçam os seus direitos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • GESTÃO DE PROJETOS (40%)
  • Planejar e coordenar com autonomia a execução das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e padrões de qualidade definidos pela organização.
  • Elaborar e executar estratégias de recrutamento de participantes e acompanhar a participação continuamente; e de mitigação de riscos.
  • Utilizar as ferramentas de comunicação e gestão de projetos da Empodera para o planejamento e atualização das ações do projeto.
  • Realizar relacionamento com parceiros locais e internacionais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, entregas, relatórios e responsabilidades, e promovendo articulação e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua das metodologias, oficinas, ferramentas de trabalho e estratégias de mitigação de riscos, propondo ajustes e soluções operacionais.
  • Realizar treinamentos sobre a metodologia do projeto e sobre espaços seguros e inclusivos para meninas e mulheres no esporte, abordando gravidez na adolescência, liderança, direitos, enfrentamento à violência, racismo e outras formas de opressão.
  • Apoiar estratégias de comunicação e divulgação dos resultados do projeto, garantindo visibilidade e sistematização dos aprendizados.
  • Participar em eventos e reuniões de articulação comunitária, redes, workshops, conferências e congressos relacionados à temática dos projetos da Empodera.
  • GESTÃO DE PESSOAS E LIDERANÇA DA EQUIPE (35%)
  • Orientar e acompanhar a equipe do projeto, oferecendo suporte técnico, assegurando coerência metodológica e acompanhamento do plano de trabalho.
  • Liderar processos de feedbacks individuais, planos de desenvolvimento profissional e de compensação.
  • Apoiar processos relacionados à equipe, como recrutamento, desligamento, acompanhamento de ponto, de acordo com as políticas institucionais.
  • MONITORAMENTO, AVALIAÇÃO E PRODUÇÃO DE CONHECIMENTO (15%)
  • Elaborar, revisar e sistematizar relatórios, materiais didáticos e produtos de conhecimento, incluindo diagnósticos, artigos e guias de atividades, atuando com autonomia na consolidação das informações.
  • Desenvolver/adaptar o plano e ferramentas de monitoramento e avaliação (M&A), acompanhar indicadores, analisar dados e propor ajustes para aprimorar a execução e alcançar resultados.
  • Coordenar e acompanhar a equipe no processo de inserção de dados na plataforma digital de coleta de dados dos projetos (checagem e inserção de fichas de inscrição, apoio e acompanhamento do lançamento de presenças).
  • GESTÃO ADMINISTRATIVA E ORÇAMENTÁRIA DO PROJETO E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (10%)
  • Apoiar e organizar processos administrativos do projeto, incluindo documentação, planejamento de atividades, logística de oficinas e treinamentos, interface com áreas internas e prestação de contas.
  • Manter estreita articulação com os demais departamentos da Empodera (RH, DP, Administrativo e Financeiro), seguindo os fluxos e processos estabelecidos.
  • Acompanhar a execução orçamentária, garantindo conformidade com o planejamento e normas internas, e reportando ajustes necessários à gestão e coordenação financeira.
  • Participar de reuniões internas, grupos de trabalho, comitês temáticos e representações externas, fortalecendo a articulação institucional e a troca de conhecimentos.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de setores e processos institucionais, fortalecendo a estrutura organizacional e a implementação de boas práticas, com autonomia na execução das tarefas delegadas.

Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As a Mechanical Engineer, you are responsible for providing technical expertise in mechanical systems across the fleet, ensuring operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and compliance with industry standards. This role involves troubleshooting mechanical issues, supporting audits by regulatory agencies and clients, and providing strategic technical recommendations to enhance operability, increase business revenue, and safeguard equipment performance. The Mechanical Engineer plays a key role in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Technical Risk Assessment (TRA), and management of change (MoC), ensuring adherence to best practices and continuous process improvement. By aligning technical action plans with organizational objectives, the engineer helps drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities

  • You provide mechanical expertise to identify and resolve technical issues across the fleet, developing and implementing action plans to enhance system reliability and operability.
  • You support regulatory agency audits, as well as internal and client audits, ensuring compliance with industry standards and company policies.
  • You offer technical recommendations aimed at improving equipment protection, optimizing control device performance, and highlighting potential technical risks. You contribute to the development of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and participate in Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), proposing actionable plans to mitigate risks and prevent future issues.
  • You play a key role in the company’s Strategy and Governance, ensuring alignment with best practices, Class issues, regulatory requirements, and GTS standards.
  • You drive Continuous Improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize mechanical processes and systems, proposing initiatives, and ensuring their implementation aligns with company goals. You provide technical support to unit operations, guiding management decisions with expert insights on mechanical systems.
  • You assist the Supply Chain in evaluating technical proposals for services or materials that deviate from like-for-like standards, ensuring quality and compliance. You serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for evaluating Management of Change (MoC) and QnA in mechanical disciplines, ensuring thorough analysis and proper documentation. You develop and issue Technical Notes and Guidelines, sharing lessons learned and promoting best practices across the fleet to enhance operational performance and compliance with company standards.
  • You define and execute a 3-Year Plan (3YP) related to Mechanical scope, supporting budget exercises and strategic initiatives. You promote interface with suppliers, vendors, and subcontractors, conducting technical interviews and participating in meetings.

Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Mechanical Supervisor

Background

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • A Mechanical Technician is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives, Instrumentation probationer techs.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Dismantle, repair and reassemble mechanical equipment; identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling; use correct procedures and method of dismantling; carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure; identify, check and prepare components; apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Use of condition monitoring on mechanical equipment; adjust instruments to meet operating specifications; minimize disruption and waste; monitor and record work history.
  • 3) Diagnose faults in mechanical equipment; respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures; select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures; carry out visual, close and detailed inspections; use inspection results to determine actions; record a full description in the history.
  • 4) Monitor and maintain pollution control measures; identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible and report according to policy, procedure and regulation; use relevant PPE; dispose of equipment and materials per procedure; enforce environmental protection with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Contribute to health and safety of the working environment; keep work areas clean and free of hazards; take positive action to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors; raise alarms and report incidents to the supervisor.
  • 6) Emergency response; carry out emergency response role (see Station Bill) and demonstrate competence in drills and exercises.

  • Offshore - Routine servicing of systems and equipment
  • Offshore - Rectifying faults in systems and equipment
  • Offshore - Handover

  • Offshore - Diagnosis and fault finding
  • Offshore - Planning work
  • Offshore - Dismantling, repair and reassemble equipment
  • Offshore - Safety management

  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.

  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Proven experience and/or qualified in PRV/PSV calibration or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with PSV calibration (offshore preferred).
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR CRANE AND HYDRAULIC MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Extensive experience in Hydraulic Cranes Maintenance. Offshore environment would be preferable.

Location

  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development

  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware — safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use — from large enterprise data center installations to half‑rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard — and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Career Growth –

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

A Truly Global Team –

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility That Works for You –

Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting?   • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games

  • Basic web hacking knowledge

Working knowledge

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp

Benefits

  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects

  • A competitive salary

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
Kubernetes Engineer

ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.

Job location

Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.

English language requirement

This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.

Overview

The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right‑sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Kubernetes engineering, platform engineering, or cloud‑native infrastructure roles.
  • Hands‑on experience with some Kubernetes distributions (RKE2, AKS, EKS, GKE, VMware Tanzu, or upstream).
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Experience with OpenLens and other K8s management tools.
  • Strong understanding of container orchestration, container runtimes, registries, and image security.
  • Expertise with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, FluxCD/ArgoCD, Helm).
  • Experience with Linux system administration and OS‑level troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of networking concepts (CNI, load balancers, service mesh, DNS, ingress/egress).
  • Experience with CSI persistent storage solutions and cluster storage migrations.
  • Knowledge of DevOps tooling: CI/CD, GitOps, monitoring/observability, vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust and cybersecurity controls in production environments.
  • Ability to collaborate across cross‑functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).
  • Experience with GKE and enterprise virtualization platforms.
  • Experience designing Kubernetes platforms for AI/GPU workloads.

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.
